notes.text: The oblique marginal note begins “ici il faut supposer” and states dim X=1, followed by a demand to “voir|revoir” the definition. Its second sentence begins “autre façon de dire -- il faut que”. The words “soit considéré”, “pour donner des|pour définir des”, the tentative noun “traits”, and part of “henséliens ou locaux au” remain uncertain. The candidate does not turn these tentative words into a mathematical conclusion.

Circled 5 introduces a subset J, its inverse image in the lifted X-prime, and G(I,J), abbreviated G-prime, as the subgroup of G(I) preserving J. The canceled “D. Voici les structures” is replaced above the line by “Donc G-prime”, leading to the actions on J, on its inverse image, and on (24).

No date is present. The roles and hands of the faint pagination marks are not established here. The main reader retained the extension-letter ambiguity and the doubtful marginal predicates; the decorated X is a consistent alphabet encoding, not an inferred change of variable.

The page writes a map (22) from the lifted point set to Hom(T(overlined Q), pi_1(X-prime)), says it is compatible with the fundamental-group actions and refines “la donnée de” the small varphi (index uncertain: varphi|varphi_i) in (17), then writes the assembled map (23). It says the latter is compatible with the action-group operations and specifies that the action on T(overlined Q), via Gamma, must also be included. This is an account of the source assertions, not a proof of them.

The source has a top-right 4 and a separate bottom-left 7. Both are retained. The exact role of the latter number is not inferred. The point after the family Phi is read as a full stop. The foot of Phi is thick and retraced, and has not been transcribed as a separate subscript or underline. The different-reader audit and main reinspection leave the physical segmentation of the thickened foot open: a canceled small index is not excluded, but no separate character can be read.
